propositions: The bugfix-size attestation gate blocks large bug fixes (>150 non-test lines) lacking an op-cert signed by a pinned environment, but only the prod op-cert environment is pinned and no in-repo client exists to obtain its signature

A developer's locally-signed plan-review attestation is rejected by classify_plan_review_attestation when the signing environment is not in the pinned trusted_environments.yaml keyring, returning verdict=mismatch (BLOCK) instead of checking whether a valid plan review was actually completed

The gate design requires cross-host verification against a trust root (pinned environments) that is not extensible to contributors, making the criterion unsatisfiable for any contributor-authored change unless their environment is CODEOWNERS-pinned

The attestation check conflates two orthogonal concerns: the SOURCE of certification (who signed, checked via keyring lookup) and the FACT of certification (whether a plan review happened and is lifecycle-valid), and must be changed to gate only on the fact, not the source
